paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak Ḥakula (see above, R. Yitzḥak ben Tavla). R. Abba bar Zavda, in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Mi SheMet, halakhah 1, and chapter Shenei Dayyanei Gezerot. R. Abbahu, in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Get Pashut, halakhah 1. In R. Hoshaya's name, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of chapter HaZorek Get. R. Ze'eira, R. Abba bar Zavda, R. Yitzḥak ben Ḥakula, in R. Yehudah Nesia's name (see his entry). In Ḥizkiyah's name, Orlah, chapter 1, halakhah 2; and R. Yehoshua ben Levi. In R. Yannai's name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Taraf BaKalpi, halakhah 1; and R. Shimon son of Rabbi, Jerusalem Talmud, end of chapter 1 of Sukkah and chapter 2 of Ketubbot, halakhah 8.
